title: Men's Gym – Twelve Labors. Zero Cardio. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the lifter who will do twelve labors before he does one minute on the treadmill, zipped on for the warm-up and the walk to the squat rack.
art: A bearded lion-headed Greek hero in a pleated tunic and sandals strides stiffly on a treadmill drawn like a vase painting, in terracotta and black with a worn print texture.
headline: TWELVE LABORS.
inks: terracotta and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash
layout_story: TWELVE LABORS. runs above it in two lines and ZERO CARDIO. below in collegiate slab capitals, the last line wider than the first
layout_faq: TWELVE LABORS. above the hero and ZERO CARDIO. below
chest: a small ZERO over CARDIO. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back
warm2: cold garage gyms, early warm-ups and the drive home
gift_line: for the gym friend who skips the treadmill and never skips leg day.
seo_desc: A greek gym zip up hoodie: TWELVE LABORS. ZERO CARDIO. on the back over a lion-headed hero on a treadmill, plus stitched ZERO CARDIO. lettering on the chest.
